title: B2B Contact & Social Media Enricher Input

startUrls.title: Target Website URLs or Domains
startUrls.description: List of company websites or Google Maps business URLs to enrich.

maxCrawlDepth.title: Max Crawl Depth per Website
maxCrawlDepth.description: Depth of subpages to explore for contact data (1 = homepage + contact/about pages, 2 = nested subpages).

maxRequestsPerDomain.title: Max Pages per Domain
maxRequestsPerDomain.description: Maximum number of subpages crawled per domain to conserve runtime and respect target servers.

extractEmails.title: Extract Email Addresses
extractEmails.description: Scrapes and cleans visible and obfuscated emails ([at], mailto: links, contact forms).

extractPhones.title: Extract Phone Numbers
extractPhones.description: Extracts tel: links, international E.164, and local phone patterns.

extractSocials.title: Extract Social Media Profiles
extractSocials.description: Extracts company LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and GitHub links.

extractTechStack.title: Detect Tech Stack
extractTechStack.description: Identifies CMS, e-commerce platforms, analytics, live chat, and JavaScript frameworks.

extractSchemaOrg.title: Extract Schema.org / LocalBusiness JSON-LD
extractSchemaOrg.description: Parses structured metadata including business addresses, opening hours, and geo coordinates.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. Uses Apify Residential/Datacenter proxies if enabled.
